title: Send num_ctx and add context-window governance for Ollama chat
description: Ensure Ollama requests include explicit num_ctx and add guarded context-window controls to prevent accidental VRAM overrun on local GPUs.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from reviewed finding that configured context values are not fully reflected in request payload behavior; this blocks reliable local deployment tuning.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented Ollama payload wiring so configured MemorySmith:Chat:OllamaContextWindowTokens emits options.num_ctx for both complete and streaming chat requests. Added provider regression test coverage. Remaining scope: stricter context-window governance UX and limits policy follow-up.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: 2026-07-10 triage: Moved from InProgress to Backlog. Core num_ctx wiring and tests are complete. Remaining governance UX/limits policy work has been dormant since May 30. Will revisit when Ollama context-window management is actively prioritized. See architectural-stability-cleanup-sprint-20260710.md.
